== Biography ==
'''Eliza Glasgow''' was a daughter of [[Glasgow-3902|Adam Glasgow]] and [[Unknown-760890|Rose]]. The Glasgow family gravestone at Tamlaght O'Crilly Lower identifies Rose as Adam's wife and then records their daughter Eliza, aged 26.<ref name="TamlaghtStone">[https://www.oneirishrover.com/tamlaght-graveyard/ “Tamlaght O'Crilly Lower Graveyard”], Glasgow gravestone transcription, accessed 29 August 2026.</ref>

The monument establishes that Eliza died aged 26 and was buried or commemorated in this family plot. It does not preserve her death date or state her birth place or place of death.
